business_summary: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, imports, and exports pharmaceuticals, non-pharmaceutical products, veterinary pharmaceuticals, agricultural and industrial chemicals, and reagents in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Ethical Pharmaceuticals Business and Consumer Healthcare Business segments. It also provides cosmetics, health foods, alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, food additives, livestock feed, hygienic goods, medical devices, health equipment, hygiene facilities and equipment, beauty appliances, and measuring and analytical equipment. The company also offers products in the gastrointestinal field, including therapeutic agents for functional dyspepsia, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, and gastritis and ulcers; laxatives; therapeutic agents for hypophosphatemia, and iron deficiency anemia; long-acting calcium channel blockers; oral NSAID; anti-leukopenia after radiotherapy products; and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory ophthalmic solutions. In addition, it provides consumer healthcare products, such as nutritional health drugs, remedies for gastrointestinal diseases, western herbal medicines, cold remedies, ophthalmic solutions, anti-inflammatory/analgesics, hemorroidal remedies, dermal remedies, quasi-drugs/cosmetics, nutrient tonics, soft drinks/health foods, and food for specified health uses. Further, the company engages in insurance agency and real estate business. The company was formerly known as Zeria Yakusho Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zeria Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in May 1970. Zeria Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외에서 의약품, 비의약품, 수의학 의약품, 농공업용 화학물질, 시약을 제조, 판매, 수입 및 수출합니다. 회사는 윤리적 제약 사업과 소비자 건강 관리 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 또한 화장품, 건강식품, 주류, 청량음료, 식품첨가물, 가축사료, 위생용품, 의료기기, 건강기기, 위생시설 및 장비, 미용기기, 측정 및 분석 장비 등을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 기능성 소화불량, 궤양성 대장염, 크론병, 위염 및 궤양 치료제를 포함한 위장 분야 제품도 제공하고 있습니다. 완하제; 저인산혈증 및 철결핍성 빈혈 치료제; 지속성 칼슘 채널 차단제; 경구용 NSAID; 방사선 치료 제품 후 항백혈구감소증; 및 비스테로이드성 항염증성 안과용 용액. 이 밖에도 영양건강의약품, 위장질환 치료제, 양약, 감기약 등 소비자 헬스케어 제품을 제공하고 있다.
